info.title: KAIRA API
info.description: KAIRA - voice-first business operations backend. All endpoints return the envelope {success, data, error}. Money is a decimal string, dates are ISO 8601. Browser clients authenticate with HttpOnly cookies and must send X-CSRF-Token on unsafe methods; see docs/API_CONTRACT.md.

Operation.description: One structured business operation. Values are null unless stated in the transcript.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional client key. Omit it to let the server generate one. Supply it to register a payment the client may already have sent with this key (it is then linked to the recorded payment).

payment_date.title: Payment Date
payment_date.description: Defaults to the business's today when executed.
